# DharmBodh

DharmBodh is a Hindi website focused on Sanatan Dharma, Hindu religious knowledge, devotional traditions, mantras, puja methods, vrat and festivals, temples, stories and quizzes.

## Main sections
- https://dharmbodh.co.in/dharma-gyan.html — धर्म ज्ञान
- https://dharmbodh.co.in/devi-devta.html — देवी-देवता
- https://dharmbodh.co.in/dharmik-katha.html — धार्मिक कथाएँ
- https://dharmbodh.co.in/puja-vidhi.html — पूजा-विधि
- https://dharmbodh.co.in/vrat-tyohar.html — व्रत-त्योहार
- https://dharmbodh.co.in/mandir.html — मंदिर
- https://dharmbodh.co.in/mantra.html — मंत्र
- https://dharmbodh.co.in/quiz.html — धार्मिक प्रश्नोत्तरी
